name: Keepassxc
tagline: A free and open-source password manager. It started as a community fork of KeePassX (itself a cross-platform port of KeePass).
description: KeePassXC is a free and open-source password manager. It started as a community fork of KeePassX (itself a cross-platform port of KeePass).

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/keepassxc:2.7.12@sha256:267bc745b3cdd3d05276ad62c8e039031eec0c5d2323b3fb2f5f6df32110efdb
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
    ports:
      - target: 3000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 3001
        published: 3001
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
